expressions.title: The Judges (Compulsory Leave) Order, 1970
expressions.title_basis: p1 (book p.192) prints the end of the Second Schedule of the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order and its signature, then '*THE JUDGES (COMPULSORY LEAVE) ORDER, 1970 PRESIDENT'S ORDER No. 27 OF 1970 [19th December, 1970]' (block 2340064) and Articles 1-2, continued on p2 (p.193) to the signature 'A. M. YAHYA KHAN ... President and Chief Martial Law Administrator' (block 2340078); its margin notes on p1 (blocks 2340056-2340058) belong to it. The preceding Order's tail is a fragment, and the Dissolution of West Pakistan Province (Rights, Properties, Assets and Liabilities) Order, 1971 that follows on p2 is held released as document 7267: both are set aside as apparatus (owner policy q1 'split').
